annotations.title: Save a book to my Shortlist

description: Save one book to the linked reader's Shortlist, the private place for books they might read, kept apart from their reading shelves. Suits "add X to my shortlist", "save X for later" and "I might read X". Want to Read is a shelf, so "add X to my want to read" is add_to_library. A book already on a shelf stays there and comes back with onShortlist false and its readingStatus. A note replaces the one saved with the book. Needs a linked Siftivo account.

notes.description: Why they saved it, in their words, private to them
